notes: Mask colours are not paint: #000 in mask-image gradients (pattern backdrop fade, phone nav edge fade) only sets mask opacity and is not a palette colour.

Journal home order (homeBlocks): personal = hero, publications, research, updates; lab = hero, research, publications, updates. Home research is a numbered ruled list (.ed-topics, 20px serif titles and Accent numerals); .ed-cards remains for Join. Hero: affiliations as .ed-affil (separator rides the preceding item), optional editorial.labRole, one quiet 14px profile row of scholarly IDs (Scholar, ORCID, GitHub as Body text links with a Caption ↗ and sr-only "(external link)"; omitted when none) under the bio, other profiles in the contact band and footer; reach row is the email only (500 Ink, wraps; resting 1px Rule Strong underline at 4px offset, Ink on hover and focus); Fig. 1 is a compact plate (12px inset, art max 116px) at <=640px; personal actions run publications, CV, Prospective students (when a position is open); lab actions run Positions, People, Research. Home drops the research lede when the hero has a tagline.

Journal paper rows: Ink titles, ↗ (Caption) when off-site plus sr-only "(external link)", Accent with an underline on hover and focus; the title is the paper link, so there is no separate Paper meta link; owners bold (every member on a lab site, boldedAuthors); a Code link and an inline "Cite" BibTeX <details>, on home too; venue tile hidden at <=640px; above that the meta-line venue is screen-reader only when the tile already shows the full name (no venueShort, or venueShort equals venue), and visible when the tile shows a different venueShort. Year-only news dates carry sr-only "In {year}".

Journal hit areas: small text links reach 44px via padding-block plus an equal negative margin-block. The mode toggle shows the word "system" in that state. The phone nav fade appears only with data-more.
Owner content carries dir="auto"; zero-specificity [dir=auto] rules align it to the column edge except .ed-prose. Roman numerals sit in <bdi>.
Dark contact band: the Light button hovers to accent-hover (Selection Wash fell to 1.4:1).

Classic: home ordered by homeBlocks with About after the proof (personal: hero, publications, research, About, updates; lab: research first); a research ruled list; News and Blog in one updates row; 44px news rows, title first in the link name; ★ Featured legend; .pub-badge 12px; no portrait = hero actions stack in the end column; one 20px h2 scale on home (no tint band); TopBar hidden on personal sites when the hero role line covers the affiliation; only the header is sticky on phones; MobileNav and search are native modal <dialog>s (search on dm tokens, with a no-results browse fallback); theme toggle cycles light, dark, system; footer copyright is one string with <bdi>, page row has a visible label; header icon buttons are 44px hit areas drawn at 32px; PostCard and FeedItem use stretched title links.

Classic hero backdrop: a pattern fades out toward the hero text's start edge (mirrored in RTL) and draws its grid lines at half the surface-200 rule contrast, so the name and role never sit on full-strength lines; waves keeps its own wave mask.

Admin: nav item "Scholar & AI"; Projects, Talks and Positions in a disclosure. Buttons act in place; links navigate. Focus trap includes summary and skips unreachable elements (closed <details>, checkVisibility). Modals are exempt from .adm-main width caps; dashboard and Posts are is-narrow (880px). Phone summaries stay list-item at 44px. New entries: Title, then Slug.

Admin site editor (.adm-editor-*): review mode (is-review) puts the review and bar before the preview in the DOM; a review rail at >=1400px (clamp(18rem, 100% - 802px, 22rem)) with a sticky preview and the diff spanning both columns; one column below; Desktop (scaled) preview lays out at 1280px and scales to the column; per-request "What changed" summary from the agent; a Session menu holds Pause and Start over; drawn status-line markers (spinner, check, exclamation, ring); the .astro note only in the publish confirm; Undo shown only when published.undoable; the bar reads text first and action last (a non-publisher's "Ready for review" line follows the file count, before Discard…); phone bar buttons split the width at 44px; deploy confirmation polling; "How this works" disclosure; focus moves after Run ends and after Publish.

Night palettes: html[data-night] from editorial.night (lamplight default and fallback, inkwell, galley). Each sets the primitive --ed-* tokens and --ed-ink-filter; everything else derives. NIGHT_HOVER in src/lib/colors.ts mirrors each --ed-hover (tested).

Font stacks (both themes): Latin face, Latin fallback (Georgia / Helvetica Neue), --font-script, generics, so Latin text in an Arabic-script site stays in its family on a cold load (font-display optional shows the fallback).

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Quiet Journal"**

A ScholarOS site reads like a well-edited journal page: white paper, one ink-dark voice for text, one accent color, and hairline rules doing the work that boxes and shadows do elsewhere. Authority comes from typesetting rather than decoration. Names, titles and long reading are set in a serif; interface and metadata in a clean grotesque sans. Tabular numerals keep dates and counts aligned. Structure is announced by headings, meta lines and 1px rules, never by colored panels or cards stacked on cards.

The system is quiet so the research is loud. Density is moderate: generous vertical rhythm between sections (56–104px), tight scannable rows within them (paper lists, news, talks, posts, CV entries, alumni). Motion is limited to small acknowledgements: a link underline that draws in, a row tint on hover, an arrow that nudges 4px, the mode toggle's half-disc turning. All transitions stop under `prefers-reduced-motion`, and the hero video stays on its poster.

The public theme ships as `journal` (code id `editorial`, the default in `config/site.yml`); `classic` remains as a frozen legacy theme with its own type scale (see Classic theme, at the end). The admin is deliberately neutral: a plain tool that shares the journal's tokens (accent, IBM Plex Sans, rules) without its serif titles or editorial patterns. The journal is one system with many shapes: personal and lab sites, light and dark, LTR and RTL, and any owner-chosen accent or font pairing all read as the same journal. Everything the owner configures (accent per mode, font families, hero backdrop, image shape, home blocks) is a variable inside this language, never an exit from it.
keyCharacteristics: Serif for identity and reading (Source Serif 4), sans for interface (IBM Plex Sans), mono for code, BibTeX and package names (IBM Plex Mono).
One accent per mode, owner-selectable, used sparingly for links, primary actions, the active nav underline, venue short-names, numerals and the brand mark.
Rules, not boxes: 1px hairlines separate content, 2px Ink rules mark open-card top edges, aside tops and active tabs.
Flat surfaces. Depth comes from tint and tone; the only shadow is on floating admin UI.
Light and dark modes; dark is the journal at night, in one of three owner-selectable palettes: Lamplight (the default), Ink Well or Galley Proof. Ink line-art plates invert with the mode.
1080px content measure, 680px reading measure, 32px gutters (16px on phones).
Any language: interface strings come from one table, dates follow the site's locale, and Arabic-script sites drop tracking, uppercase and italics.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one accent hue on any screen. No secondary brand color, no teal-plus-navy pairing in the same mode, and no colored section backgrounds.

rules.name: The Caption Floor Rule
rules.body: No text is lighter than Caption Gray in light mode or dark-caption in dark mode. An owner-chosen accent must also clear 4.5:1 against Paper in its mode; in dark mode the build lifts it until it does, measured on the chosen night palette's Hover.

rules.name: The One Band Rule
rules.body: Only one inverted region exists per page: the contact band at the bottom of the home page. Heroes, sections and callouts stay on Paper; affiliations ride the hero's role line (`.ed-affil`), never a band of their own.

rules.name: The Serif Speaks, Sans Serves Rule
rules.body: Names, page/paper/post titles, venues, quotes and reading text are serif. Navigation, buttons, metadata, labels, form fields and compact card headings are sans. Never set long reading in sans or interface in serif.

rules.name: The Tabular Dates Rule
rules.body: Every date, year, count and statistic uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so columns of numbers align.

rules.name: The Joined Script Rule
rules.body: Arabic-script languages (`ar`, `fa`, `ur`, `ps`, `ckb`, `sd`, `ug`) get no letter-spacing, no case transform and no italics: one rule in `src/styles/global.css`, shared by both public themes, resets all three, because tracking and synthetic italics break joined letterforms. Uppercase labels and italic taglines simply set upright and untracked there. The same languages set `--font-script` (Vazirmatn, Geeza Pro, Noto Naskh Arabic, Segoe UI, Tahoma), the slot both themes' stacks place after the Latin fallback (Georgia / Helvetica Neue), so Latin text keeps its family on a cold load while Arabic letters, which those faces lack, fall to a real Arabic face. Vazirmatn is fetched only for these languages (`FontStyles.astro`); the rest are system faces.

rules.name: The Heading-Is-The-Label Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a heading. There are no eyebrow or kicker labels over titles. Uppercase tracked text survives only where it _is_ the heading (`h2` section labels: home News and Blog, research Software, people groups, project status groups, positions and join groups, CV sections, contact and repository groups). What a kicker used to carry (role, category, owner, tags) lives in a meta line under the heading: the role line under the hero name, the 14px Caption meta line, bylines.

rules.name: The Shared Edge Rule
rules.body: Every row rule sits on the column edge. A row's hover tint may bleed 12–16px past the column (negative inline margin, 6px radius), but its divider does not: it is drawn as a 1px centered gradient at `calc(100% − 2 × bleed)`, or on the unbled list item. Rules from different lists, heads and sections all start and end on the same vertical line.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: If it isn't floating above other content, it has no shadow. Cards, tiles, buttons, plates and heroes are flat.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: No classic text is smaller than 12px. Badges and labels that were 10px are 12px; pinned items say so in words, not with an emoji.

dos: **Do** separate content with 1px Rule hairlines and reserve 2px for open-card tops, aside tops and active underlines.
**Do** keep every row rule on the column edge while the hover tint bleeds past it.
**Do** put role, category and tag information in a meta line under the heading.
**Do** set every date, year and count in tabular numerals.
**Do** draw standalone arrows with the 16px, 1.5px round-stroke Arrow; keep inline → ↗ ← as typeset text in the link.
**Do** ship line art as ink on transparency and let the build mark it for dark-mode inversion; keep photos as photos.
**Do** keep text at Caption or darker in light mode and dark-caption or lighter in dark mode.
**Do** give every interactive element a 44px minimum target and the 2px Accent focus ring.
**Do** use logical CSS properties so RTL sites mirror cleanly, in the admin as well.
**Do** take every interface string from `ui-strings` and format every date with the site's locale.
**Do** keep the header to six links with Contact pinned, and list the rest in the footer index.
**Do** keep the admin neutral: sans headings, ruled rows, the journal's accent and rules, persistent error toasts.
donts: **Don't** put an eyebrow or kicker label above a heading. Uppercase tracked text is only ever the heading itself.
**Don't** use gradients, glows or colored section backgrounds. The hero backdrop stays an Ink hairline pattern or an image under a Paper wash.
**Don't** use pill-shaped buttons or tags, or radii above 8px (circular or oval portraits and the mode toggle's disc excepted).
**Don't** put shadows on public-page elements. Shadows are for floating admin UI only.
**Don't** introduce a second accent hue. A night palette brings its own accent in place of the light one, never beside it; no neon.
**Don't** use emoji or icon-font glyphs as icons.
**Don't** letter-space, uppercase or italicize Arabic-script text.
**Don't** bring serif titles, numerals, tiles or open cards into the admin.
**Don't** set navigation, buttons or form fields in the serif, or long reading text in the sans.
**Don't** let configurable options (hero type, home blocks, accent, fonts) introduce a layout that exists only in one mode. Personal, lab, light, dark, LTR and RTL share every component.
